description: Summary figure: structural neighbours, CAP tetrad occupancy, ortholog conservation and C-terminal tail identity of R3HDML
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, matplotlib.patches as mpatches

pairs = pd.read_csv("work/tm_pairs.csv")
sub = pairs[(pairs.A=="R3HDML_mature")|(pairs.B=="R3HDML_mature")].copy()
sub["other"] = np.where(sub.A=="R3HDML_mature", sub.B, sub.A)
sub = sub[sub.other!="R3HDML_CAP"].sort_values("TM_min")
grp = {"PI15_CAP":"PI15/PI16 clade","PI15_mature":"PI15/PI16 clade","PI16_CAPregion":"PI15/PI16 clade",
       "CRISPLD2_CAP":"other human CAP","GLIPR1_mature":"other human CAP","CRISP2_mature":"CRISP (with CRD)",
       "CRISP3_mature":"CRISP (with CRD)","GAPR1_1SMB":"other human CAP","PR1_1CFE":"non-vertebrate CAP",
       "NaASP2_1U53":"non-vertebrate CAP","Pry1_5ETE":"non-vertebrate CAP","Tablysin15_3U3N":"non-vertebrate CAP",
       "Natrin_1XTA":"CRISP (with CRD)","Stecrisp_1RC9":"CRISP (with CRD)","Triflin_1WVR":"CRISP (with CRD)"}
col = {"PI15/PI16 clade":"#2b6cb0","other human CAP":"#48bb78","CRISP (with CRD)":"#dd6b20","non-vertebrate CAP":"#805ad5"}

tet  = pd.read_csv("work/tetrad_geometry.csv").reset_index(drop=True)
cons = pd.read_csv("work/ortholog_conservation_summary.csv").reset_index(drop=True)
O    = pd.read_csv("work/ortholog_scoring.csv")

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14,10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2,2, hspace=0.55, wspace=0.35)

ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
ax.barh(sub.other, sub.TM_min, color=[col[g] for g in sub.other.map(grp)])
for y,(v,n) in enumerate(zip(sub.TM_min, sub.seq_id_struct)):
    ax.text(v+0.005, y, f"{v:.2f} ({n*100:.0f}% id)", va="center", fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_xlim(0,1.15); ax.set_xlabel("TM-score vs R3HDML (normalised by shorter chain)")
ax.set_title("A  Structural neighbours of human R3HDML (AF-Q9H3Y0, 57-253)", fontsize=10, loc="left")
ax.legend(handles=[mpatches.Patch(color=c,label=k) for k,c in col.items()], fontsize=7.5, loc="lower right")
ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)

ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
cols4 = ["H1","E2","E3","H4"]
mat = np.array([[1 if str(tet.loc[i,c])[0]==("H" if c[0]=="H" else "E") else 0 for c in cols4] for i in range(len(tet))])
ax.imshow(mat, cmap="RdYlGn", vmin=0, vmax=1, aspect="auto")
for i in range(len(tet)):
    for j,c in enumerate(cols4):
        ax.text(j,i,str(tet.loc[i,c]),ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(range(4)); ax.set_xticklabels(["tetrad H1","tetrad E2","tetrad E3","tetrad H4"], fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(tet))); ax.set_yticklabels(tet.protein, fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("B  CAP tetrad occupancy (green = canonical His/Glu)", fontsize=10, loc="left")

ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
keys = ["H1_108","E2_119","E3_141","H4_168","CAP1_H70","CAP1_R74","CAP2_Q171","CAP2_W174",
        "Cys182","Cys187","Cys205","Cys225","Cys228","Cys236","Cys241"]
cc = cons.set_index("feature").loc[keys].reset_index()
ax.bar(range(len(keys)), cc.pct_conserved, color=["#e53e3e" if k=="E2_119" else "#2b6cb0" for k in keys])
ax.set_xticks(range(len(keys))); ax.set_xticklabels(cc.position, rotation=60, fontsize=8, ha="right")
ax.set_ylim(0,105); ax.set_ylabel("% identical across orthologs"); ax.axhline(95, ls=":", lw=0.8, color="grey")
ax.set_title(f"C  Conservation across {len(O)} vertebrate R3HDML orthologs\nQ119 (red) replaces the canonical tetrad Glu in 99.3% of species", fontsize=10, loc="left")

ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
cl = pd.DataFrame({"region":["R3HDML 208-253","PI15 212-258","CRISP2 ShKT","CRISP3 ShKT","Triflin CRD","Stecrisp CRD"],
                   "nCys":[4,4,8,8,10,10],"TM":[1.0,0.640,0.058,0.060,0.103,0.120]})
ax2 = ax.twinx()
b1 = ax.bar(np.arange(6)-0.2, cl.TM, width=0.4, color="#2b6cb0", label="TM-score vs R3HDML C-term")
b2 = ax2.bar(np.arange(6)+0.2, cl.nCys, width=0.4, color="#dd6b20", label="cysteines in region")
ax.set_xticks(range(6)); ax.set_xticklabels(cl.region, rotation=30, ha="right", fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("TM-score vs R3HDML 208-253"); ax2.set_ylabel("cysteines in region")
ax.set_title("D  The R3HDML C-terminal tail is a PI15-type tail, not a CRISP CRD", fontsize=10, loc="left")
ax.legend([b1,b2], ["TM-score vs R3HDML C-term","cysteines in region"], fontsize=7.5, loc="upper right")
plt.show()
